# Mister Download Manager

> Mister Download Manager (MDM) is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) download manager for Windows 10 and 11, with experimental builds for macOS and Linux. It is laid out like Internet Download Manager (IDM) — toolbar, categories, download list, progress window with every connection, queues and scheduler — and is not affiliated with Tonec Inc. In its published benchmark against IDM 6.42 on the same computer and server it was faster in all seven scenarios (5.4× on a 1 GiB file, 106× on a 256 KiB file).

Key facts:
- Price: free, no ads, no trial, no paid edition. Licence: GNU GPL 3.0. Source: https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager
- Downloads: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPS (explicit and implicit TLS), BitTorrent and magnet links, and videos from web pages via yt-dlp. Proxies, SOCKS and PAC scripts.
- Engine: up to 32 connections per file (8 by default; 128 once allowed in Options), dynamic re-splitting, crash-safe resume, checksum verification, refresh of expired download links, per-server connection limits learned automatically.
- Browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi (Firefox in testing): hands downloads over with cookies and referrer, right-click "Download with Mister Download Manager", a draggable "Download video" button over videos. Without the extension, copying a link to a file opens the download window.
- 86 interface languages (every Windows 11 display language), right-to-left layouts for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur.
- Imports IDM's export files (.ef2). Accepts IDM's command-line switches (/d /p /f /a /n /s). Has a CLI (misterdownloadmanager-cli, with --json output for scripts and agents) and a local token-protected automation API, described by a JSON Schema.
- AI assistants: an MCP server (misterdownloadmanager-mcp) lets Claude, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients list, add, pause, resume and remove downloads in the running app.
- Privacy: the app has no accounts, no analytics, no telemetry; a weekly update check against GitHub that can be turned off.
- Written in Rust with egui. Made by Ahmed Nefzaoui and contributors.
